harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: stores in front of a warp shuffle inside the loop: the unwaited rewrite of its source and the two covers under that traffic - on a Workstation Edition card, the probe alone

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: c8d79a6 The sm_120 dependency table prices the upper register of an IMAD.WIDE result apart, and CS2R -> IMAD is 6: two p

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256

requests.pair: SHFL.BFLY.src <- IADD3.it (unwaited rewrite of the source register behind a warp shuffle; the shuffle carries no read barrier; the overwriter adds (iteration index + 1) x a constant: one late iteration per thread is decoded to its index + 1)

SHFL.BFLY.src <- IADD3 (unwaited rewrite of the source register behind a warp shuffle; the shuffle carries no read barrier; the overwriter stands BEHIND the reader that waited the shuffle's write barrier - distance = waiter -> overwriter)

SHFL.BFLY.src <- IADD3 (unwaited rewrite of the source register behind a warp shuffle; the shuffle carries no read barrier; the tested shuffle has NO write barrier either: a younger shuffle 1 cycle(s) behind it carries one, the reader waits that and takes both results, the overwriter stands behind the reader - distance = waiter -> overwriter)
